name: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
shortDescription: Explore intelligent systems, data analysis and machine learning.
description: The department focuses on programming, data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning and practical problem solving.

name: Computer Engineering
shortDescription: Build software, systems and computing solutions.
description: Students study programming, algorithms, databases, operating systems, networks and software development.

name: Information Technology
shortDescription: Connect technology, information and real-world applications.
description: The programme covers software engineering, web technologies, databases, networks and information systems.

name: Mechanical Engineering
shortDescription: Understand design, manufacturing and mechanical systems.
description: The department introduces engineering design, manufacturing processes, thermal systems and mechanics.

name: Electronics and Telecommunication
shortDescription: Discover electronics, communication and embedded systems.
description: The programme covers electronic circuits, communication systems, signal processing and embedded technologies.

name: Civil Engineering
shortDescription: Design and understand infrastructure and the built environment.
description: Students explore structural engineering, construction materials, surveying and environmental engineering.
